summary.zh: 从分支和历史记录继续暂停的实验
summary.en: Continue a paused experiment from its branch and history.

description.zh: 读取实验所在的分支、配置和历史结果，从中断处继续推进。适合长任务被暂停、上下文丢失，或换了一台机器之后恢复使用。
description.en: Picks a paused or interrupted experiment back up by reading its branch, config and result history, then continues from where it stopped. Use it after a long task was paused, context was lost or you moved to another machine.
